what: [disk] cap-vm-logs target runtime_logs scans the WRONG directory. Dry run 2026-11-20 (issue #27658, run 44684110819) reported 'runtime_logs root: /home/ubuntu/ict-trading-bot/runtime_logs' (~87 MB, 0 candidates), while the 12 GB of runtime logs live under /data/bot-data/runtime_logs (disk-usage-report run 44681992412). Cause: scripts/ops/cap_vm_logs_action.sh calls scripts/ops/cap_runtime_logs.py without load_runtime_env, so DATA_DIR / RUNTIME_LOGS_DIR are unset and src.utils.paths.runtime_logs_dir() falls back to the repo-relative dir (the same class as BL-20260717-FILLS-STORE-PATH-SPLIT). Fix: load_runtime_env (or pass --root from the canonical resolver) in the wrapper, plus a test; then re-dry-run against /data/bot-data/runtime_logs. Note the real 12 GB may be LIVE .jsonl files (bybit_coverage_soak.jsonl 253 MB, signal_audit.jsonl 218 MB), which need a writer-side cap, not this tool. || [2026-11-20 AM-OPS-11] Fix in PR #27707 (load_runtime_env + a test with a negative control). After merge: re-dispatch the dry run and read the root line before any apply. Live .jsonl writer caps are separate.
